cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(nyasm VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)

option(NYASM_X86 "Build x86 and x86-64" ON)
option(NYASM_ARM64 "Build AArch64" OFF)
option(NYASM_RISCV64 "Build RISC-V RV64" OFF)
option(NYASM_RISCV32 "Build RISC-V RV32" OFF)
option(NYASM_ENCODE "Build the encoders" ON)
option(NYASM_FORMAT "Build the text formatters" ON)
option(NYASM_METADATA "Build names, briefs, features, traits, operand rows and effects" ON)
option(NYASM_UIR "Build the UIR semantics and term store" ON)
option(NYASM_KERNEL "Build with the kernel flag set" OFF)
option(NYASM_EXAMPLES "Build the examples" OFF)

add_library(nyasm src/nyasm.c)
add_library(nyasm::nyasm ALIAS nyasm)
set_target_properties(nyasm PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF
   C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} SOVERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR})
target_include_directories(nyasm PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
   $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}> PRIVATE src)
target_compile_definitions(nyasm PRIVATE NYASM_BUILD PUBLIC $<$<BOOL:${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}>:NYASM_SHARED>)
foreach(choice NYASM_X86 NYASM_ARM64 NYASM_RISCV64 NYASM_RISCV32 NYASM_ENCODE NYASM_FORMAT NYASM_METADATA NYASM_UIR)
   target_compile_definitions(nyasm PUBLIC ${choice}=$<BOOL:${${choice}}>)
endforeach()

if(NOT MSVC)
   target_compile_options(nyasm PRIVATE -ffreestanding $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU>:-fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns>
      $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:Clang,AppleClang>:-fno-builtin>)
endif()

if(NYASM_KERNEL AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
   message(FATAL_ERROR "NYASM_KERNEL builds a static library only.")
endif()

if(NYASM_KERNEL)
   target_compile_options(nyasm PRIVATE -fno-builtin -fno-stack-protector -mgeneral-regs-only
      $<$<STREQUAL:${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR},x86_64>:-mno-red-zone -mcmodel=kernel -fno-pic>)
endif()

if(NYASM_EXAMPLES)
   add_subdirectory(examples)
endif()

install(TARGETS nyasm EXPORT nyasmTargets)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(EXPORT nyasmTargets NAMESPACE nyasm:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/nyasm)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/nyasmConfig.cmake.in nyasmConfig.cmake
   INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/nyasm)
write_basic_package_version_file(nyasmConfigVersion.cmake COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/nyasmConfig.cmake
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/nyasmConfigVersion.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/nyasm)
